requests.title: Privacy requests
requests.intro: Export everything held about a member, or erase their personal data at their request. Every request is recorded in the audit log.
requests.selectDistrict: Select a district to manage privacy requests.
requests.approveConfirm: Approve erasure of {name}? Their personal data will be removed permanently and cannot be recovered.

create.title: New privacy request
create.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or mobile (at least 2 characters)
create.exportHelp: Prepares a ZIP of everything held about the member. You receive a download link by email when it is ready; it works for seven days.
create.eraseHelp: Removes the member's personal data permanently. Payments, attendance and reports keep their records under an anonymous name. Another District Admin must approve before it runs.
create.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Written request from the member received on…
create.reasonRequired: Give a reason for the erasure.
create.eraseConfirm: I understand this cannot be undone.

consent.title: Your privacy
consent.body: {brandName} keeps your Rotary membership details so your club and district can work with you. Please read how we use and protect your data before you continue.
